"Naturally" is a song performed by American band Selena Gomez & the Scene, taken from their debut studio album Kiss & Tell (2009).
It was released by Hollywood Records as the album's second single in the United States and select other countries.
The song was produced by Antonina Armato and Tim James who wrote the song with Devrim Karaoglu.

American singer Selena Gomez has released three solo studio albums, one collaborative studio album, one compilation album, five extended plays (EPs), 36 singles (including five as a featured artist), nine promotional singles, and two charity singles.
Gomez's first solo studio album, Stars Dance, was released in July 2013 and debuted at number one in both the United States and Canada.
Its lead single, "Come & Get It", became a top-ten hit in the US, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
Selena Marie Gomez (born July 22, 1992) is an American actress, singer, songwriter, businesswoman, and producer.

Gomez began her career as a child actress on the children's television series Barney & Friends (2002–2004), and emerged as a teen idol for her leading role as Alex Russo on the Disney Channel sitcom Wizards of Waverly Place (2007–2012).
